dedupe_keys.name: experimental quantification of tsunami driven debris damming on structures

description: Experimental Quantification of Tsunami-driven Debris Damming on Structures is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Hyoungsu Park, University of Hawaii Manoa (hawaii.edu). This experimental project investigated the debris accumulation in front of structures during tsunamis (debris damming), which leads to an increase in the forces imposed by tsunami flow on structures. The study was conducted through the construction of a 1:20 geometric scale physical model. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Debris, tsunami, damming load, column structure. Published 2024-07-15. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
